# The Realty Bazaar — Complete LLM Reference Documentation

> The Realty Bazaar (https://therealtybazaar.com) is a comprehensive Indian PropTech platform and property marketplace. It provides real estate brokers with a mobile app for automated marketing, social media syndication, paid Meta Ads campaign management, and customer relationship management (CRM). It also provides property seekers with a verified, direct-contact property discovery portal.

---

## 1. Executive Summary

- **Company Name**: The Realty Bazaar
- **Primary Website**: https://therealtybazaar.com
- **Target Audience**:
  1. Indian Real Estate Brokers, Agents, Channel Partners, and Brokerage Agencies.
  2. Property Buyers, Renters, and Commercial Real Estate Investors across Indian cities (Surat, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Vadodara, Pune, Bengaluru, etc.).
- **Platforms**:
  - Public Website (Discovery, SEO, Direct Leads): https://therealtybazaar.com
  - Broker Mobile Application: iOS & Android (Inventory management, AI content generation, ad automation, CRM).

---

## 2. Platform Architecture & Separation of Concerns

1. **Broker Operations (Mobile-First)**:
   - Real estate brokers manage their entire day-to-day business through The Realty Bazaar mobile app.
   - Brokers upload photos/videos of properties, generate AI captions/hashtags, schedule and run paid Meta Ads, track inbound leads from all channels, set follow-up tasks, schedule site visits, and manage pipeline deals from their mobile devices.
2. **Public Marketplace (Web Portal)**:
   - The web platform is a public property discovery engine for buyers and tenants.
   - No login or registration is required for consumers to browse verified properties.
   - When a broker publishes a property on the mobile app, it instantly appears on the public website with complete specifications, photo galleries, locality tags, and direct broker contact links.
   - Consumer enquiries from the website automatically route into the listing broker's mobile CRM in real time.

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### For Property Seekers
1. **Do I need an account to search or browse properties?**
   No. All published listings across India can be explored freely without creating an account.
2. **Can I contact the listing broker directly?**
   Yes. Each property listing provides direct Call and WhatsApp buttons with the verified listing broker.
3. **Are properties listed by verified professionals?**
   Yes. Listings are uploaded directly by local real estate agents who manage active inventory.
4. **Can I schedule a physical site visit?**
   Yes. Property pages include a 'Schedule a Site Visit' action to request your preferred date and time.
5. **Are there any buyer fees to use the platform?**
   No. Discovery and contacting brokers is completely free for buyers and tenants.

### For Real Estate Brokers
1. **Is The Realty Bazaar a CRM?**
   Yes, but it also combines AI marketing content creation, automated Instagram/Facebook publishing, paid Meta Ads management, and a public discovery marketplace.
2. **Where do brokers upload listings?**
   Brokers manage everything through the dedicated mobile app on their phone.
3. **How does paid advertising work?**
   The platform creates, tests, and optimizes Meta Ads campaigns targeting verified buyers in specific micro-markets, delivering leads directly into the mobile CRM.
